image_description: A close-up view of a large whale breaching or surfacing in dark ocean water. The whale has a dark grey, mottled skin with white patches (barnacles/callosities) on its head and rostrum. Notably, there is a bright orange object attached to the side of the whale's body near the blowhole area, which appears artificial. The head is arched, and the body curves into the water. No dorsal fin is visible, consistent with grey whales, but the posterior knuckles are obscured by water and angle.
